title: Startup India FoF 2.0: What it means for Indian startups and micro-VCs
summary: The government launches Startup India FoF 2.0 with a ₹10,000 crore corpus targeting venture and growth capital, with a deep-tech focus. It will channel funds through SEBI-registered funds, via SIDBI as implementing agency, signaling a major shift for startups and micro‑VCs.
suggested_angle: Explain practical steps for startups and micro-VCs to align with FoF 2.0: who can expect funding, how to position for deep-tech opportunities, and a simple 3‑step plan to approach fund managers.
why_relevant: India’s funding landscape is expanding with a deep-tech focus; founders and operators should plan how to align product bets and funding searches with FoF 2.0.

title: New Economy Collective (NEC): Opportunity for Indian startups to go global
summary: Startup Policy Forum (SPF) launches NEC to connect Indian startups with global markets and ease market-entry, compliance, and partnerships. It enables two-way flows of investment, talent, and collaboration—opening channels for localization tooling, cross-border partnerships, and outbound expansion.
suggested_angle: Highlight three concrete ways to leverage NEC: (1) partner and co-create go-to-market services, (2) use localization/compliance tooling, (3) pursue cross-border partnerships—with quick scripts for outreach.
why_relevant: Global expansion is a key growth lever; NEC provides a structured path for Indian startups to access new markets.

title: Kwik Ads: AI-powered performance marketing for Indian D2C brands
summary: GoKwik’s Kwik Ads uses autonomous AI agents for signal enrichment, creative research, benchmarking, and analysis, claiming ~25% ROAS uplift and ~15% CAC reduction with demos and partner case studies.
suggested_angle: Give a practical 3-step pilot plan: choose a product, run 2-3 ads, and measure ROAS; outline metrics to track and when to scale using AI.
why_relevant: Indian D2C brands can materially improve efficiency with AI-driven signals and automated creative; highly actionable for viewers.

title: Google consent controls: key changes for GA Ads integration starting June 15, 2026
summary: Ads settings will govern data usage in line with user consent; 90-day grace; destination-specific controls; implications for tracking, attribution, and tag configuration across linked properties.
suggested_angle: Provide a practical 5-point checklist to reconfigure GA4/Ads tagging for consent, plus 2 tests to run this week to preserve attribution accuracy.
why_relevant: Tracking and attribution across ads and analytics will change; advertisers must adapt to avoid wasted spend and biased metrics.

title: AI Audience Builder: natural-language segmentation for regulated retailers
summary: Springbig launches an AI Audience Builder with conversational segmentation designed for regulated retailers, enabling smarter targeting with compliance in mind.
suggested_angle: Walkthrough: how to build audience segments using natural language prompts and show 2–3 example campaigns for regulated verticals.
why_relevant: Regulated sectors face unique constraints; AI-enabled segmentation makes compliant targeting faster and more scalable.

title: Mass Customizer: AI-driven TV creative at scale
summary: Marketing Architects’ Mass Customizer enables AI-powered TV creative personalization at scale without exploding production costs, enabling localised or personalised broadcast.
suggested_angle: Do a quick demo concept: feed a brand brief and show how ad variants adapt; discuss cost and time savings in a 45–90 second clip.
why_relevant: TV/CTV creative is expensive; AI tooling can unlock scalable personalization for growth campaigns.

title: The $500B blind spot in creator marketing: how to measure and maximize creator impact
summary: Forbes identifies a large, under-measured opportunity in creator media; discusses measurement and integration into paid and distribution strategies.
suggested_angle: Share 3 metrics to evaluate creator ROI, highlight common measurement gaps, and give a quick example of a creator-led campaign ROI uplift.
why_relevant: Creator ROI is a high-priority topic; viewers need practical measurement frameworks to justify creator partnerships.

title: RBI SGB 2019-20 premature redemption on 15 April 2026: what it means for small investors and treasury decisions
summary: Redemption price around ₹15,009 per unit; discuss liquidity, potential tax implications for individuals, and how to rebalance portfolios or reallocate funds.
suggested_angle: Walk through two to three scenarios based on common holdings, with quick arithmetic and a take on tax treatment for individuals.
why_relevant: Investors among the audience hold SGBs; redemption impacts cash flow and short-term planning.
